{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute the Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
# This automatically drops rows with any missing values
pearson_corr = df['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df['body_mass_g'])

# Print the correlation coefficient with 3 decimal places
print(f"{pearson_corr:.3f}")

# Print the effective sample size
n_eff = len(df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']))
print(f"{n_eff}")"}
